implementation_summary: Registered one allRoutes row per AUDIT_API and AUDIT_AI_API entry, with method, path and access from the contract and beta 'allow' only for public rows. Handlers delegate to the real audit route rows, built lazily per runner by buildAuditRoutes(server) with the real store, settings store, key port, AuditRuns, the BE-192 pipeline as the start route's afterCrawl step, rewrite store, preview generator and Helper access. Added the contract test. AUDIT_API.content and AUDIT_API.file have no route implementation, so they are excluded in NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the AC-2 and beta tests fail on them.

Production RunnerServer wiring: server.ts (outside ownership) must pass helperAccess so dispatch helperGrants and refusals work; public getters for dataDir, keyResolver, helperAccess, readAiModels and carriesAccessKey would replace the private-member cast in routes/index.ts
risks: routes/index.ts reads private RunnerServer members through an unknown cast; a rename fails at runtime, not at compile time
Without RunnerServerOptions.helperAccess, Helper rows use an env-based HelperAccess but dispatch ignores it
Env PAGESPEED_API_KEY counts as a saved key in the settings key port
Rewrite state is a local file per version; on a cloud store it lives under <dataDir>/audit-rewrites and is not shared across instances
